item.summary: India Post is set to accelerate its transformation with a combined financial outlay of ₹2,632 crore for the Postal Operations and Estates Management Schemes for the 16th Finance Commission Cycle (FY 2026 - 27 to FY 2030 - 31). This includes ₹1,141 crore for the proposed continuation of the Postal Operations Scheme and ₹1,491 crore for the Estates Management Scheme, whose continuation has been…
item.title: India Post Accelerates Its Transformation with ₹2,632 Crore Financial Outlay Following Cabinet Approval
